notes: Fixed Diagonal Slices layout for negative angles. Root cause: centerOffset and colWidth formulas assumed positive shear. For positive shear, the leftmost panel point is the bottom-left corner (shifted right by shearOffset), so centerOffset = -shearOffset offsets the layout leftward. For negative shear, the leftmost point is the top-left corner (no horizontal shift), so centerOffset should be 0. The colWidth formula similarly adapts: W + shearOffset for positive shear, W - shearOffset for negative shear. Fix is a conditional branch on shear >= 0 vs shear < 0. User visually verified the fix works. All existing unit tests pass.
